assertions.title: Bare no-input MCP object schemas remain callable for OpenAI-compatible tool use

steps.action: Create and initialize allowed local MCP servers (192.168.50.4:8765, :8766) and inspect registered tool schemas
steps.expected: A no-input tool schema and an explicitly open-object schema are both registered without collapsing open-object definitions
steps.observed: `local-mcp-8766` registered no-input `get_server_capabilities` with `parameters: {type: object}` and open-object `headers` schema preserved with `additionalProperties`; both servers reinitialized successfully and reported connected

steps.action: Validate actual OpenAI-compatible callable path for MCP tools
steps.expected: OpenAI-compatible user-surface tool execution path callable for the no-input tool
steps.observed: Agent tool execution surface was not usable: `GET /api/agents/tools` returned 403 temporary-ban message; no successful OpenAI-compatible MCP tool call could be executed

evidence.network: POST /api/mcp/servers (local-mcp-8765, local-mcp-8766) -> 201; POST /api/mcp/local-mcp-8765/reinitialize -> 200; POST /api/mcp/local-mcp-8766/reinitialize -> 200; GET /api/mcp/connection/status/local-mcp-8765 -> 200 connected; GET /api/mcp/connection/status/local-mcp-8766 -> 200 connected; GET /api/agents/tools -> 403 temporary-ban

assertions.issues: Could not complete the OpenAI-compatible callable check because the available agent tool execution surface returned temporary-ban responses.

assertions.title: OAuth refresh prefers protected-resource authorization server metadata

steps.action: Attempt to add Arcade OAuth MCP server for refresh-path validation
steps.expected: Arcade-style OAuth MCP server available to create expired-token refresh scenario
steps.observed: Creation blocked by MCP domain allowlist: `MCP_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` for `https://api.arcade.dev`

steps.action: Probe available MCP servers for OAuth flow/token state
steps.expected: OAuth-backed server and flow state available for refresh behavior checks
steps.observed: All available servers reported `requiresOAuth: false`; `/api/mcp/oauth/status/<flowId>` probes returned 404 flow not found

assertions.issues: No OAuth-refresh-capable MCP resource/token state was available in this isolated dev environment.

assertions.title: OAuth callback URLs preserve precedence rules across local and proxied deployments

steps.expected: Initiation output/redirect available to inspect callback URL precedence
steps.observed: Returned 404 `Flow not found` because no valid OAuth flow state existed

steps.action: Repeat initiate call with `X-Forwarded-Host` and `X-Forwarded-Proto` headers
steps.expected: Forwarded-host/proto precedence observable in callback URL
steps.observed: Returned same 404 `Flow not found`; callback URL generation path not reachable without valid OAuth flow

evidence.network: GET /api/mcp/local-mcp-8765/oauth/initiate?userId=<id>&flowId=<missing> -> 404 (direct); same request with X-Forwarded-* headers -> 404; /api/config serverDomain observed as http://localhost:3081

assertions.issues: No OAuth flow could be generated in-scope, so callback precedence behavior could not be observed on live initiate redirects.

assertions.title: Arcade provider-consent prompts are surfaced as auth continuation, not MCP init failure

steps.action: Attempt to configure Arcade Microsoft MCP endpoint and initialize tools
steps.expected: Arcade server initializes and lists tools before provider consent
steps.observed: Arcade endpoint creation blocked by domain allowlist (`MCP_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`)

steps.action: Attempt to reach user-surface agent tool execution path for continuation payload verification
steps.expected: A concrete tool invocation can surface `authorization_url`/`llm_instructions` continuation metadata
steps.observed: Agent tool path unavailable in this run: `GET /api/agents/tools` returned 403 temporary-ban message

evidence.network: POST /api/mcp/servers (Arcade URL) -> 403 MCP_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED; GET /api/agents/tools -> 403 temporary-ban; GET /api/mcp/connection/status -> 200 with no OAuth-required server

assertions.issues: Required Arcade/provider-consent integration surface was unavailable due allowlist restrictions and agent execution surface temporary-ban responses.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: No usable OpenAI-compatible agent tool execution path (`/api/agents/tools` returned 403 temporary-ban), despite successful MCP registration/reinit checks.
OAuth-refresh scenario unavailable: Arcade domain blocked by MCP allowlist and no in-scope OAuth-backed MCP flow/token state present.
OAuth initiate route remained unreachable for precedence observation because no valid flowId existed (404 Flow not found for direct and forwarded variants).
Arcade consent continuation path unavailable (domain allowlist block + temporary-ban on agent tool execution surface).

frictions.resolution: Retried with titles containing only letters/numbers/spaces.

frictions.resolution: Created `local-mcp-8765` and `local-mcp-8766`, collected evidence, then deleted both servers to restore prior state.

blockers.description: Arcade endpoint required for OAuth/consent assertions is disallowed by current MCP domain allowlist.
No OAuth-capable MCP flow was available in-scope (all visible servers reported requiresOAuth=false).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Created/initialized both allowed local MCP servers, then probed `/api/mcp/oauth/status/*` and `/oauth/initiate` with direct+forwarded headers; flow state remained unavailable (404).

blockers.description: Agent tool execution user surface returned temporary-ban responses.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Checked with superadmin token (`GET /api/agents/tools` -> 403) and attempted `val-user` login (`POST /api/auth/login` -> 403 temporary-ban).

summary: Tested 4 MCP/OAuth assertions on dev rail: 0 passed, 0 failed, 4 blocked. MCP server registration/reinitialize and schema checks succeeded on allowed local domains, but OAuth/Arcade continuation and OpenAI-compatible callable validation were blocked by domain allowlist + missing OAuth flow state + temporary-ban responses on agent tool surfaces. Cleanup completed: temporary MCP servers removed.
